chapter: Trumpet styles and early New Orleans scene
title: Clarinetists and Mealie Barnes
summary: They identify a downtown clarinetist as Mealie Barnes, who worked with Buddy Petit.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: I found that fella they'd be insane in them games. Such as? Hmm?
I said like uh, George Boyd and Zeb, what's his name, Zeb?

And uh, he played with Rennie and this guy played with Bocard Petit, he's downtown now, way downtown there. That beats me. Yeah, he got a house down there, he don't play much now. You ask Raph about it, Raph took me to his house. Raph knew him good. He lives downtown. Way downtown, yeah.

Yeah, you just ask Raph about it because, I mean I went down there with Raph and he was supposed to make up, we were supposed to get together but I never did hear from him no more. I can't call his name. Can't call his name to save my life. But he from way downtown there. Was he look like? Used to be a good kind of player with all his teeth out in the front.
Tall, dark fellow. Well that'd be to me, we'll figure out who he is. Mealy Barnes.
Mealy Barnes, that's him. Oh sure. That's him, Mealy Barnes. And who did he work with? He worked with Buddy, and Buddy, Buddy,
Well I was hoping you could get together with him.
Well that's what I thought too, but.
Well he never did get any jobs done on him. He quit playing music.
He was worried about that house, you know, getting his house built. Mealy Barnes, yeah that's the fellow.
But he worked a lot with Buddy, huh?
